_comment: Билды паладина для tools/run_sims.py. Режим siml: драйвер генерирует полный '.siml'-setup (use репозиторного APL + транскрибированные настройки билда + секция gear). Обновляй строку template при заметных изменениях defaults.siml/билдов сима.

builds.template:
siml 1
spec retribution_paladin
talents "050250002-501-05233011201301351"
use "{{APL}}"

settings:
  race human
  profession1 engineering
  profession2 blacksmithing
  reaction_time 100ms
  distance_from_target 25

consumables:
  offensive_pot major_spellblasting_potion
  resource_pot major_mana_potion
  flask flask_of_supreme_power
  food lobster_stew
  conjured demonic_rune
  mh_imbue shadow_oil
  extra r_o_i_d_s, goblin_sapper_charge, dragonbreath_chili, gordok_green_grog
  elixir elixir_of_holy_power, elixir_of_sages, elixir_of_the_mongoose, elixir_of_the_owl, elixir_of_the_grizzly, elixir_of_the_phalanx, greater_arcane_elixir, greater_mageblood_elixir, juju_might

buffs:
  greater_blessing_of_kings
  greater_blessing_of_might 1
  greater_blessing_of_wisdom 1

party_buffs: mana_spring_totem

raid_buffs:
  arcane_intellect, prayer_of_spirit, mark_of_the_wild, power_word_fortitude
  strength_of_earth_totem 1
  grace_of_air_totem 1
  windfury_totem
  battle_shout 1
  leader_of_the_pack

debuffs:
  judgement_of_light, judgement_of_wisdom, curse_of_elements, curse_of_recklessness, faerie_fire
  expose_armor, sunder_armor

sim:
  iterations {{ITERS}}
  fixed_rng_seed {{SEED}}

encounter:
  duration 180
  duration_variation 5
  execute_proportion_20 0.2
  execute_proportion_35 0.35
  targets(id=31146, name="Raid Target", level=63, mob_type=mechanical,
      stats(attack_power=320, block_value=54, armor=3731, health=1428900),
      min_base_damage=2601, damage_spread=0.5, swing_speed=2, parry_haste, can_crush)

gear:
{{GEAR}}

siml 1
spec protection_paladin
talents "050050002-05302102213301531-502"
use "{{APL}}"

settings:
  race human
  profession1 engineering
  profession2 enchanting
  reaction_time 100ms
  in_front_of_target
  distance_from_target 5
  healing_model(hps=2200, cadence_seconds=0.4, cadence_variation=1.2, absorb_frac=0.02, burst_window=6, inspiration_uptime=0.25)
  tanks player1

consumables:
  defensive_pot greater_stoneshield_potion
  flask flask_of_supreme_power
  food baked_salmon
  conjured demonic_rune
  explosive ez_thro_dynamite_ii
  mh_imbue brilliant_wizard_oil
  extra goblin_sapper_charge, juju_might, scroll_of_stamina_iv
  elixir elixir_of_holy_power, greater_arcane_elixir, elixir_of_the_owl, elixir_of_sages, elixir_of_greater_fortitude, greater_mageblood_elixir, elixir_of_greater_defense, elixir_of_ferocity, elixir_of_the_mongoose

buffs:
  thorns, greater_blessing_of_kings
  greater_blessing_of_might 1
  greater_blessing_of_wisdom 1

party_buffs: mana_spring_totem

raid_buffs:
  arcane_intellect, prayer_of_spirit, mark_of_the_wild, power_word_fortitude, shadow_protection
  grace_of_air_totem 1
  windfury_totem
  battle_shout 1
  leader_of_the_pack

debuffs:
  judgement_of_the_crusader, judgement_of_light, judgement_of_wisdom, curse_of_elements
  curse_of_recklessness, faerie_fire, expose_armor, sunder_armor, gift_of_arthas
  demoralizing_shout, insect_swarm

sim:
  iterations {{ITERS}}
  fixed_rng_seed {{SEED}}

encounter:
  duration 180
  duration_variation 5
  execute_proportion_20 0.2
  execute_proportion_35 0.35
  targets(id=31146, name="Raid Target", level=63, mob_type=mechanical,
      stats(attack_power=320, block_value=54, armor=3731, health=1428900),
      min_base_damage=2601, damage_spread=0.5, swing_speed=2, parry_haste, can_crush)

gear:
{{GEAR}}

builds.disabledReason: В ui/specs/paladin/holy нет ни defaults.siml, ни APL: пресет Holy в симе ещё не готов. Когда появятся — включи запись: disabled:false + строка template по образцу ретри/прота.
